name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 113
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: Calls, further, on the Commission to integrate cancer-specific indicators into the European Semester process, building on the European Cancer Inequalities Registry, so as to enable systematic and comparable monitoring of Member States’ performance across the full cancer pathway, from prevention and early detection to treatment and survivorship, and to use Country-Specific Recommendations as an accountability tool to address persistent cancer inequalities across the EU;
